description.text: Objectives:Trainings of highly qualified medical professionals who bears the fundamental theories on basic and clinical medicine.These medical professionals should undertake medical diagnosis, treatments and prevention on common and frequently occurring diseases of oral cavity in health and medical institutions. Degree Awarded:Bachelor of Medicine Employment Orientation: Graduates are supposed to undertake teaching and oral diseases treatments in medical schools, hospitals and clinics at all levels.

duration.text: The Nursing at Huazhong University of Science and Technology is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4583 USD/per year ￥ 33000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Certificate of HSK Certificate of HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test) 2. Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included 3. Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant 4. High school academic transcript 5. High school graduate certificate Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization.

requirements.text: High school graduates or above, be healthy.
